sonnet.problem: Verse 47:13 says only 'This is what the Lord GOD says' and then addresses 'you' (Israel), who are to divide the land. The card says God 'tells him [Ezekiel] how to divide the land', which names a listener the text doesn't give and suggests Ezekiel does the dividing.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. ❌ "God tells the nations, 'Be still.'" ✅ "Then God speaks: 'Be still…'" (Ps 46:10)
